subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT the lead bank?
solution:
The correct answer is __**HDFC Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lead banks** are banks that have the responsibility of leading the consortium of banks in a particular region to coordinate the banking services.
 
• **HDFC Bank** is a private sector bank and is not designated as a lead bank in the Lead Bank Scheme.
 
• The **Lead Bank Scheme** was introduced by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** in **1969**.
 
• Only public sector banks and a few private sector banks are designated as lead banks, and HDFC Bank is not one of them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Canara Bank**__

 __
 
• **Canara Bank** is a **public sector bank** and is designated as a lead bank in several districts.
 
• It was established in **1906** in **Mangalore, Karnataka**.
 
 
 
• **State Bank of India**__
 __
 
• The **State Bank of India (SBI)** is the largest public sector bank in India and serves as a lead bank in many regions.
 
• SBI was established in **1955** and has its headquarters in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
 
 
• **Indian Bank**__
 
 
• **Indian Bank** is another public sector bank that acts as a lead bank in various districts.
 
• It was founded in **1907** and is headquartered in **Chennai, Tamil Nadu**.
